name: Documentary Style
core_identity: Observational documentary footage of ordinary life as it happens, unstaged and slightly imperfect. It feels as if a field crew was simply present and did not interfere. Available light, cluttered real places and people who ignore the camera make it recognizable.
medium: Documentary photography and handheld video frame, captured on location with available light.
lighting: Available light only: overcast sky, a window, fluorescent tubes or a bare bulb, sometimes uneven or mixed in colour. Exposure can be a little flat, with windows slightly blown out. No added fill lights and no glamour rim light.
color_palette: Natural, slightly desaturated colours with mixed real-world white balance, such as a greenish tube light beside a bluish window. Skin looks plain and neutral, contrast is moderate and shadows stay open.
camera: Handheld feel with a 24 mm to 50 mm lens look at eye level. Wide establishing shots show the place, and observational medium shots from a few metres away are sometimes caught slightly off-moment. Moderate to deep depth of field with little background blur.
composition: Subject often off-centre or partly cut by a doorway or another person. Real environments with clutter such as signs, tools, laundry and furniture, in layers of foreground and background. Candid timing rather than a perfect pose.
texture: Slight digital noise in the shadows, a hint of motion softness, and honest detail in peeling paint, dust, scuffed floors and worn tools. No heavy grain and no stylised filter.
characters: Ordinary people of all ages shown at work or in daily life, with unposed postures, natural faces and uneven skin. They look at their task or at someone else, not at the camera. Clothing is practical and plain, with sweat, creases, aprons, work gloves or faded jackets as the setting needs.
negative: cinematic color grade, staged pose, looking at camera, glamour lighting, studio lighting, perfect symmetry, anime, cartoon, illustration, painting, 3D render, CGI look, plastic skin, airbrushed skin, oversaturated colors, text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, distorted hands, deformed face, duplicate people, blurry
motion_rules: Gentle handheld drift with a small natural sway, slow pans that follow a person or reveal the place, and occasional slow reframing. Subjects keep going about their task: walking, working, talking to someone off-frame. No dramatic dolly, crane, whip pan or slow motion.
